WITH
        /* 1. Lấy mẫu bệnh phẩm trong khung thời gian chỉ định (Tập dẫn dắt) */
        MBP AS
        (
            SELECT /*+ MATERIALIZE */
                   km.maubenhphamid,
                   km.khambenhid,
                   km.sophieu,
                   km.loainhommaubenhpham,
                                      km.khoaid,
                   km.phongchuyendenid,
                   km.nguoitao,
                   km.nguoitraketqua,
                   km.ngaymaubenhpham,
                   km.ngaymaubenhpham_hoanthanh
            FROM HIS_DATA_HYN_VANGIANG.kbh_maubenhpham km
            WHERE km.ngaymaubenhpham >= TO_date('01/10/2026 00:00:00','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
              AND km.ngaymaubenhpham <= TO_date('21/10/2026 00:00:00','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
              AND km.loainhommaubenhpham IN (1, 2, 5)
        ),
        /* 2. Chỉ quét PTTT cho nhóm chỉ định PTTT (loainhom = 5) */
        KP_SUMMARY AS
        (
            SELECT kp.dichvukhambenhid,
                   MAX(kp.pttt_hangid)    AS pttt_hangid,
                   MAX(kp.phauthuatvien)  AS phauthuatvien,
                   MAX(kp.phauthuatvien2) AS phauthuatvien2,
                   MAX(kp.dieuduong)      AS dieuduong,
                   MAX(kp.userid)         AS userid
            FROM HIS_DATA_HYN_VANGIANG.kbh_phauthuatthuthuat kp
            WHERE kp.dichvukhambenhid IN (
                SELECT d.dichvukhambenhid
                FROM HIS_DATA_HYN_VANGIANG.kbh_dichvu_khambenh d
                JOIN MBP m ON m.maubenhphamid = d.maubenhphamid
                WHERE m.loainhommaubenhpham = 5
            )
            GROUP BY kp.dichvukhambenhid
        ),
        /* 3. Chỉ đọc kết quả CLS cho các mẫu bệnh phẩm đã lọc */
        KQ_SUMMARY AS
        (
            SELECT kq.maubenhphamid,
                   MAX(kq.ktvthuchien) AS ktv_thuchien
            FROM MBP m
            JOIN HIS_DATA_HYN_VANGIANG.cls_ketqua kq
              ON kq.maubenhphamid = m.maubenhphamid
            GROUP BY kq.maubenhphamid
        ),
        /* 4. Dữ liệu chính: Stream trực tiếp theo Nested Loop */
        MAIN_DATA AS
        (
            SELECT /*+ LEADING(km kdk kk kt bh) USE_NL(kdk kk kt bh) */
                   km.maubenhphamid,
                   km.sophieu,
                   km.loainhommaubenhpham,
                   km.khoaid,
                   km.phongchuyendenid,
                   km.nguoitao,
                   km.nguoitraketqua,
                   km.ngaymaubenhpham,
                   km.ngaymaubenhpham_hoanthanh,
                   kdk.dichvukhambenhid,
                   kdk.dichvuid,
                   kdk.dichvuid_org,
                   kdk.tendichvu,
                   kdk.soluong,
                   kdk.tien_chitra,
                   kdk.ty_le,
                   kdk.loaidoituong,
                   kdk.tien_miengiam,
                   kdk.tien_bhyt_bntt,
                   kt.ngaytiepnhan,
                   kt.ngay_ravien,
                   kt.trangthaitiepnhan,
                   kt.loaitiepnhanid,
                   kt.doituongbenhnhanid,
                   kt.bhyt_benhnhanid,
                   kt.machandoanravien,
                   kt.chandoanravien,
                   kt.chandoanravien_kemtheo,
                   bh.mabenhnhan,
                   bh.mahosobenhan,
                   bh.tenbenhnhan,
                   bh.diachi,
                   bh.ngaysinh,
                   bh.namsinh,
                   bh.gioitinhid
            FROM MBP km
            JOIN HIS_DATA_HYN_VANGIANG.kbh_dichvu_khambenh kdk
              ON kdk.maubenhphamid = km.maubenhphamid
            JOIN HIS_DATA_HYN_VANGIANG.kbh_khambenh kk
              ON kk.khambenhid = km.khambenhid
            JOIN HIS_DATA_HYN_VANGIANG.kbh_tiepnhan kt
              ON kt.tiepnhanid = kk.tiepnhanid
             AND kt.csytid = 89580
            JOIN HIS_DATA_HYN_VANGIANG.ban_hosobenhan bh
              ON bh.hosobenhanid = kt.hosobenhanid
        )
        SELECT
               dd.madichvu,
               nhom.tendichvu AS tennhom,
               m.sophieu,
               CASE m.loaitiepnhanid
                   WHEN 0 THEN 'Nội trú'
                   ELSE 'Ngoại trú'
               END AS loaidieutri,
               CASE m.loainhommaubenhpham
                   WHEN 1 THEN 'Xét nghiệm'
                   WHEN 2 THEN 'CĐHA'
                   ELSE 'PTTT'
               END AS loaidichvu,
               ddb.ten_dtbn,
               khoa.org_name AS khoachidinh,
               bscd.full_name AS bschidinh,
               bscd.user_name AS tkchidinh,
               phongth.org_name AS phongthuchien,
               bsth.full_name AS nguoithuchien,
               m.tendichvu,
               m.soluong,
               dd.gianhandan AS tien_chitra,
               m.soluong * dd.gianhandan AS thanhtien,
               m.tien_chitra AS gia_bhyt,
               m.soluong * m.tien_chitra * (100 - NVL(m.ty_le, 0)) / 100 AS thanhtien_bhyt,
               TO_CHAR(m.ngaytiepnhan, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS ngaytiepnhan,
               CASE
                   WHEN m.trangthaitiepnhan = 0 THEN NULL
                   ELSE TO_CHAR(m.ngay_ravien, 'dd/mm/yyyy')
               END AS ngay_ravien,
               TO_CHAR(m.ngaymaubenhpham, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS ngaychidinh,
               TO_CHAR(m.ngaymaubenhpham, 'hh24:mi:ss') AS giochidinh,
               TO_CHAR(m.ngaymaubenhpham_hoanthanh, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS ngaythuchien,
               TO_CHAR(m.ngaymaubenhpham_hoanthanh, 'hh24:mi:ss') AS giothuchien,
               m.mabenhnhan,
               m.mahosobenhan,
               m.tenbenhnhan,
               m.diachi,
               TO_CHAR(m.ngaysinh, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS ngaysinh,
               m.namsinh,
               CASE m.gioitinhid
                   WHEN 1 THEN 'Nam'
                   ELSE 'Nữ'
               END AS gioitinh,
               c.ma_bhyt,
               CASE
                   WHEN m.machandoanravien IS NOT NULL
                   THEN m.machandoanravien || '-' || m.chandoanravien
                   ELSE NULL
               END AS machandoanravien,
               m.chandoanravien_kemtheo,
               dph.pttt_hang_ten,
               ptv1.officer_name AS phauthuatvien1,
               ptv2.officer_name AS phauthuatvien2,
               kq.ktv_thuchien,
               gv.officer_name AS giupviec,
               CASE
                   WHEN m.loaidoituong IN (1, 2, 3) AND m.dichvuid_org IS NULL
                   THEN m.tien_miengiam
                   ELSE 0
               END AS miengiam_bhyt,
               CASE
                   WHEN m.loaidoituong NOT IN (1, 2, 3) AND m.dichvuid_org IS NOT NULL
                   THEN m.tien_miengiam
                   ELSE 0
               END AS miengiam_chenh,
               m.tien_bhyt_bntt AS thucthu_bhyt,
               0 AS thucthu_chenh
        FROM MAIN_DATA m
        LEFT JOIN HIS_DATA_HYN_VANGIANG.kbh_bhyt c
               ON c.bhytid = m.bhyt_benhnhanid
        LEFT JOIN HIS_DATA_HYN_VANGIANG.dmc_dichvu dd
               ON dd.dichvuid = m.dichvuid
        LEFT JOIN HIS_DATA_HYN_VANGIANG.dmc_dichvu nhom
               ON nhom.dichvuid = dd.nhomdichvuid
        LEFT JOIN KP_SUMMARY kp
               ON kp.dichvukhambenhid = m.dichvukhambenhid
        LEFT JOIN dmc_pttt_hang dph
               ON dph.pttt_hangid = kp.pttt_hangid
        LEFT JOIN org_officer ptv1
               ON ptv1.officer_id = kp.phauthuatvien
        LEFT JOIN org_officer ptv2
               ON ptv2.officer_id = kp.phauthuatvien2
        LEFT JOIN org_officer gv
               ON gv.officer_id = kp.dieuduong
        LEFT JOIN KQ_SUMMARY kq
               ON kq.maubenhphamid = m.maubenhphamid
        LEFT JOIN dmc_doituong_benhnhan ddb
               ON ddb.dtbnid = m.doituongbenhnhanid
        LEFT JOIN org_organization khoa
               ON khoa.org_id = m.khoaid
        LEFT JOIN org_organization phongth
               ON phongth.org_id = m.phongchuyendenid
        LEFT JOIN adm_user bscd
               ON bscd.user_id = m.nguoitao
        LEFT JOIN adm_user bsth
               ON bsth.user_id =
                  CASE
                      WHEN m.loainhommaubenhpham = 5
                      THEN kp.userid
                      ELSE m.nguoitraketqua
                  END
        ORDER BY
               m.ngaytiepnhan,
               loaidieutri,
               loaidichvu,
               m.tenbenhnhan
